The component's own CSS class (.origam-data-table-footer) is a standalone compound block, NOT a BEM child of data-table (contrast with data-table.json's existing 'footer' key, nested under 'data-table', which emits the mismatched --origam-data-table__footer---* — never read by this component). Values copied verbatim from OrigamDataTableFooter.vue's SCSS fallbacks, all of which reference live, currently-emitted modern semantic vars.
